scope: Verify local session and protected-data seams without contacting GoDaddy, a production Google OAuth client or a production database. No GoDaddy application, database, migration, reset, deletion, deployment or external upload was contacted.

checks.name: actual local session entry
checks.observed: Anonymous conversation access returned 401. Local development sign-in returned 200, set a fixed Max-Age=86400 cookie, and exposed an authenticated but not-yet-consented session with a fixed expiry timestamp.
checks.limit: Development sign-in is not production Google OAuth and the memory store is not GoDaddy MySQL.

checks.name: absolute-expiry and protected-data regression
checks.observed: Consent activity leaves the existing expiry unchanged. A signed cookie for an expired stored session is denied by both session lookup and protected access. Encryption tamper detection, MySQL transaction/lock seams, owner resource checks and the Google nonce seam also pass their controlled tests.
checks.limit: Controlled seams do not prove deployed key injection, Google redirect configuration or persistence across a GoDaddy restart.
